_note: REAL unsupervised clustering (DBSCAN) of the real catalog snapshot; cluster names are derived from the data (dominant name prefix + orbit regime). Mean-element orbits, TLE/OMM accuracy applies. Not an operational product.

metrics.label_caveat: the catalog's `active` group is a catch-all that shares orbits with constellations, and constellations span several shells, so purity/completeness against it are lower bounds, not targets of 1.0

congestion.note: Objects per spherical shell by mean altitude (circular approximation); density = count / (4 pi r^2 dh). Objects outside 150-2150 km are not shown. Eccentric objects cross shells they are not counted in.
